_readme: One entry per native build generation. An OTA update only reaches phones whose build has the same runtime version. If scripts/check-runtime.mjs fails, the native layer changed: bump expo.runtimeVersion in app.json to the next native-N, add it here with the new fingerprint, and build BOTH phones (preview and production).

native-1.notes: First named runtime. Native freeze build: Expo SDK 58, background location, geofence, push, haptics, plus v2 modules (camera, files, audio, video).
